steps.title: Welcome!
steps.body: Symbia is a game about creating intricate landscapes and attracting animals all while puzzling with the limited space you have. Each tile is valuable and every landscape has a purpose.

steps.title: Tutorial
steps.body: This tutorial will walk you through all elementsof the game. After this you will be ready to play the game on your own.

steps.title: Landscape Packs
steps.body: These are your landscape packs. They provide you with landscape cards to place on the board.

steps.title: Take a pack
steps.body: Click on the first landscape pack at the bottom-left to add cards to your hand.

steps.title: Pack cooldown
steps.body: Notice how the packs are now grayed out? That's because they're on cooldown. You can only take a new pack after placing all your current landscape cards.

steps.title: Placing a landscape
steps.body: To place tiles you must select the landscape card you want to place. Click on the forest (tree) card in your hand to select it.

steps.title: Place the first tree
steps.body: Hover the empty hex and click it to place your first tree.

steps.title: Stack it
steps.body: Some landscapes can be stacked on top of each other. Click the same hex again to place your second tree on top.

steps.title: Select the last tile
steps.body: Now select the field card to place the last tile.

steps.title: Place a field
steps.body: Place the field tile next to the stacked trees. We will need it later.

steps.title: Pack cooldown
steps.body: You have placed all your tiles, so the packs are no longer grayed out and available to take again.

steps.title: Reroll a pack
steps.body: If you dont like the cards in your pack, you can reroll it by hovering on the pack and clicking the reroll icon. (The small X icon). Try it!

steps.title: Reroll cooldown
steps.body: Now the reroll is on cooldown and its icon is gone. After taking 3 new packs, the reroll icon will appear again.

steps.title: Animals
steps.body: Lets add some animals to our landscape. Open the animal market by clicking the expand arrow above the packs.

steps.title: Animal Market
steps.body: Here you can see available animals. You can take one per booster. After you buy an animal, the market locks until you pick another landscape pack.

steps.title: Animal selection
steps.body: Click now on the Hedgehog card to add it to your hand.

steps.title: Select an animal
steps.body: Click the selected Hedgehog card in your hand to examine it.

steps.title: Animal cards
steps.body: The background color shows you on what type of landscape the animal can be placed. The hexes in the top right show the exact tiles and stacks the animal needs.

steps.title: Animal cards
steps.body: In the top left you see how many points you earn for this animal. The number below are its bonus points. You earn more bonus points for each animal of the same type you place.

steps.title: Animal cards
steps.body: At all times you can have only 2 animal cards on your hand. You can discard one by clicking the 'X'-button.

steps.title: Animal placement
steps.body: The hexes in the top right show the pattern of tiles needed to place the animal. The highlighted tile is where you need to place the animal itself. These placement patterns can be rotated and mirrored.

steps.title: Place the animal
steps.body: Place the animal on the field tile next to the stacked trees.

steps.title: Quests
steps.body: Here you can see your active quests. Quests are randomly drawn when you take a pack.

steps.title: Quest requirements
steps.body: Hover the quest to see its requirements. Place this pattern anywhere on the board to earn its points (bottom of the tooltip).

steps.title: Completing the quest
steps.body: To complete the quest we need to finish the pattern. We are only missing some fields. So take a pack that includes Fields.

steps.title: Place a Field
steps.body: Now lets complete the quest and earn some bonus points. Select the field.

steps.title: Complete the quest
steps.body: Place the field on the highlighted hex.

steps.title: Complete the quest
steps.body: Place the second Field on the highlighted hex to finish the triangle and complete the quest.

steps.title: Animal Bonus Points
steps.body: Now we can also place more Hedgehogs to earn their bonus points. Select the Hedgehog.

steps.title: Hedgehog bonus
steps.body: Place in on the highlighted hex. You will notice that this one now earned bonus points.

steps.title: More bonus points
steps.body: Place another Hedgehog on this Field to earn even more bonus points!

steps.title: Score
steps.body: Lets see how you have done. Here you can see your point score. Not a bad score after finishing the quest and earning all these bonus points from the hedgehogs.

steps.title: Scoring rules
steps.body: Landscape cards dont have points on their cards. They score based on randomly selected rules. Each type has their own scoring rules.

steps.title: Scoring rules
steps.body: To see the scoring rules for your session click on the 'Question'-icon in the top right corner.

steps.title: Forest scoring
steps.body: Click now on the forest icon to see this sessions's forest scoring rule.

steps.title: Forest scoring
steps.body: Here you can see the scoring rule for the forest. Take time to read it and understand how it works. When you are done click the forest icon again to close it.

steps.title: Landscape Stacking
steps.body: If you want to know how landscape tiles can be stacked on what their symbols mean click on the Book-Icon.

steps.title: Landscape Stacking
steps.body: This slide shows you each tile with their symbol and how they stack on top of each other. When you are done click the Close-button.

steps.title: Undo
steps.body: Made a mistake? Use Undo (bottom-right) to take back your last placement.

steps.title: Menu
steps.body: When you are done with the session or want to change settings open the menu.

steps.title: End session
steps.body: To end your session click on END SESSION in the menu.

steps.title: End session
steps.body: These 3 buttons allow you to restart your session. End it (progress will be saved) or share it with friends so they can replay and try to beat your score!

steps.title: You are ready!
steps.body: And thats it! You are now ready to start playing Symbia. Good luck!
